name: Campus Policy — Tuition Reform
description: A university announces a tuition and curriculum reform; students, faculty, and the public react.
seed_text: A major university announces a tuition reform that raises fees for some programs while adding new scholarships. Student leaders criticize the plan, saying it burdens low-income families. Several professors support the reform, arguing it will fund better facilities and research. Local residents worry that higher costs will push students away. A student union spokesperson said "we oppose the fee increase because it hurts ordinary families". A prominent professor praised the reform as "necessary for the university's future". Media coverage is divided, and online discussion is growing heated. The government has not yet commented.
